timing_scopes.client: Upload start through terminal job / saved Markdown / all downloaded public assets; includes polling.
timing_scopes.server_job: Persisted started_at through completed_at; includes native parsing, SDK, rendering/export and assets.
timing_scopes.docling: Official Finished converting logs include the full converter pipeline. Sum is parallel work; interval union/span is estimated wall time from 0.01s-rounded logs. Never sum with server/client durations.
timing_scopes.SDK_page_pipeline: Observed GLM_SDK_PAGE duration includes source PDF/image rendering, orientation, SDK semaphore, HTTP/retries and response parsing.
timing_scopes.SDK_HTTP: Observed accumulated POST-await time includes network, SDK CPU layout, GLM region recognition and retry HTTP attempts; excludes direction and retry sleep.
timing_scopes.legacy: Orientation-result log to next SDK HTTP response is only a separate log-derived interval, never a substitute for missing exact SDK page timing.
timing_scopes.pure_model: No kernel/model-forward/request-specific engine duration is available; remains null.
